title: Settle Customer Khata: Recording Receipts against Bills

intro.title: Customer Khata Receipts
intro.subtitle: Record customer payments, bill-by-bill FIFO allocation, UPI references, and WhatsApp vouchers

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 8, Part 2: Settle Customer Khata: Recording Receipts against Bills. In Phase 2, we issued credit sales to patients. Today, we record payments to settle outstanding Khata balances.
Go to Accounting and select Receipts, then click New Receipt. Search for the customer or family group to load all outstanding credit bills.
Choose your payment mode: Cash, UPI, or Bank Transfer. Enter the bank transaction reference number and receipt date.
Enter the amount received. MediFlow automatically allocates the payment against oldest unpaid bills in real time, safely holding any surplus overpayment as an unallocated Customer Advance.
Save the receipt to issue an audited RCT voucher and send an instant WhatsApp confirmation to the patient. In Part 3, we examine Financial Statements!

outro.takeaway: Customer Khata Receipts: Collect patient credit dues, allocate receipts against specific invoices, and issue verified WhatsApp payment vouchers.
